verdict.rationale: Caveman ships its own agent that takes plain-language instructions: you tell it what you want done, and it starts agent chats, answers their questions and reports back. It runs alongside wrapped agents such as Claude Agent, Codex and Cursor. The evidence is marketing copy only, and it does not show whether natural language can also drive administrative functions such as budgets, guardrails and automations. missing for 10: evidence that natural-language commands cover product configuration and admin functions, in-depth docs for the orchestrating agent, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Tell it what you want done. It starts the chats, answers their questions, reports back, and goes ahead on its own when you don't answer in time.
Claude Agent, Codex, Cursor and Caveman, our own agent, work side by side in tabs and splits.
The open-source Caveman CLI wraps supported agents including Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI.
